answer: Run at about 4-5 s residence time (best ~4.5 s). Binned mean CNT yield: ~26.5 g/g-cat at 4-4.5 and 4.5-5 s, 26.0 at 5-5.5, 25.1 at 3.5-4, falling to 23.3 at 3-3.5, 20.9 at 2.5-3, 15.3 at 2-2.5 and 24.4 at 5.5-6, 22.4 at 6-6.5, 18.9 at 6.5-7. Inverted-U in all four reactors (R1, R2, R4 peak 4-5 s; R3 peaks 5-5.5 at 28.1 but looks like a noisy bin). The plateau between 4 and 5 s is flat, so aim ~4.5 s; going below 3.5 or above 5.5 costs several g/g-cat. The linear trendline in the scatter (slope +0.56, R2 0.02) is misleading.
